description: C0's mesh methods (kit-of-parts pot, lid, rack; observed-point lathe blue cup) rebuilt with the same frozen public settings on each EVAL episode where the object appears; one mesh per object picked GT-free by the pre-registered rule (PREREG.md) and shipped for every eval pair of it.
status: packaged; not scored (no eval ground truth exists). Recommendation by PREREG section 6: white_pot E0, white_pot_lid E0, plastic_dish_rack E0, blue_cup E0. Owner decides what ships.

run.offer: 57321792 (Connecticut US, AMD EPYC 7K62, 96 effective cores, 252 GB RAM, $0.487/h all-in)

rule: packed mesh only; simulator copies and rollouts unchanged (as C0)
library_use: meshes/library_e0 for every eval pair except eval 8; meshes/library_e0x for eval 8 (as library_v3 / library_v3x and library_c0 / library_c0x)
